scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,chat-shell -c blue,magenta "CODEX_CHAT_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4173 npm run dev -w @ay-ple/server" "npm run dev -w @ay-ple/chat-shell"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ay-ple/codex-chat-runtime && npm run test -w @ay-ple/server && npm run test -w @ay-ple/chat-shell && npm run test:camp-demo
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @ay-ple/chat-shell && npm run test:camp-demo:e2e
scripts.build: /bin/rm -Rfx -- ./packages/codex-chat-runtime/dist ./apps/server/dist ./apps/chat-shell/dist && npm run build -w @ay-ple/codex-chat-runtime && npm run build -w @ay-ple/server && npm run build -w @ay-ple/chat-shell
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/codex-chat-runtime && npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/server && npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/chat-shell && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck:camp-demo
